_comment: Microsoft -> Odoo 5-year comparison (SPEC-022) cases, shared by backend/libs/mscalc.py, website/src/utils/mscalc.ts (tests/scripts/mscalc_parity.mjs) and mauxy (vendored copy, scripts/sync_selfcheck.py; mauxy tests/test_ms_price_mail.py runs gate + mail through the result / operator mail). expect = hand-calculated from the rules file version below (rates as in mscalc.json); when a rate changes, the cases change with it. Keys in expect are compared, others ignored. gate/mail: rules patch customer_mail_figures (bool) + confirm_all (every owner_to_confirm rate set to verified) simulates the owner's release.

compute.title: rules defaults (25 users, 10 customisations, 3 years, no partner cost): Odoo side more expensive, no break-even
NAV with heavy customisations, pending BC upgrade quote 80k, 40 Office seats
Business Central with known annual licence total (replaces users x rate)
office/SharePoint only (0 ERP users, 50 seats): no Odoo licence, hosting or ERP days
nothing to compare (0 users, 0 seats) -> null
invalid inputs (negative, string, bool, null) count as 0 -> null when users and seats end at 0
limits: users capped at 5000, history at 40, ints floored (2.7 customisations -> 2)
valid overrides apply (Odoo licence 30, Microsoft +5 % per year)
invalid overrides ignored (below min, above max, string, bool)
pending Microsoft project larger than the migration: break-even in month 1
rounding of the one-off is half up like Math.round (mid 50 -> 100, low 40 -> 0, high 70 -> 100)
users 1 counts as one started block of 10 users
